name: Launch Control
shortDescription: Texting for real estate owner lists. Skip tracing is $0.13.
longDescription: Launch Control is a texting product for real estate investors. Skip tracing is $0.13, and one plan is provider fees plus $22, with 12,500 monthly SMS. There is no single all-in monthly price.
pricingNotes: One plan is listed as provider fees plus $22, with 12,500 monthly SMS. Skip tracing is listed at $0.13. No single all-in monthly price.
bestFor: Sending texts to a list of property owners you already have
notIdealFor: Someone who wants one published price with provider fees included
strength: Skip tracing is $0.13, and one plan is provider fees plus $22 for 12,500 monthly texts.
weakness: That $22 figure is not an all-in price, because the same page adds provider fees on top.

useCaseFit.find-off-market: Sends texts to owner lists, and the pricing page lists skip tracing at $0.13.
